dataset.title: USGS 3DEP LiDAR Point Cloud — MN Central Mississippi River Work Unit 4
dataset.citation: Woolpert (2022). MN Central Mississippi River 4 2022 Lidar; Project ID: 230951 - WU300158; Classified Point Cloud. U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program. USGS Contract No. 140G0221D0013, Task Order No. 140G0222F0098.
dataset.metadataAuthority: NOAA InPort 73145 identifies this exact EPT URL and states the EPT points were reprojected horizontally to Web Mercator EPSG:3857 while NAVD88 Geoid18 vertical metres were retained.
dataset.license: U.S. Government public-domain USGS 3DEP point-cloud source. Cite USGS and dataset lineage when using derived material.

coverage.samplePointRole: camera GPS-derived search centre; not a surveyed control point

expectedFrame.basis: NOAA InPort 73145 process step 2: EPT source was reprojected horizontally to EPSG:3857; NAVD88 GEOID18 vertical meters retained. Confirm the actual ept.json SRS fields before use.

limitations: The EPT is derived from the same classified USGS 3DEP point-cloud project as the raw LAZ product, not a separate independent sensing campaign from that LAZ.
A camera GPS coordinate and EPT footprint intersection do not prove the photographed structure is the same building.
No image-derived candidate GLB, registered control points or held-out accuracy metrics have been produced.
EPT node point files will be sampled in an ephemeral directory and are not committed or uploaded as artifacts.
